codeReview.summary: The feature implements most requested registration-engine structure, but two blocking correctness issues break key requirements around session re-login behavior and custom-field handling.

issues.description: When session validation fails, `_ensure_logged_in()` calls `login_to_luma()` in a separate temporary browser context and returns True, but `register_for_event()` continues using the original context/page created earlier (line 707). The active page is never reloaded with the new storage state, so the attempt can proceed unauthenticated after an expired/missing cached session. This breaks the expected re-login-and-continue flow (VAL-REG-005/VAL-REG-007).

Unknown-field detection marks virtually every unmatched visible input as blocking because of `if is_required or field_type != "hidden"`. Since visible fields are almost never `hidden`, optional custom fields are treated as required and force `needs_input`. Requirement is to block only when required unknown fields exist (VAL-REG-010).

summary: Fail. Two blocking logic defects were found: re-login does not rebind the active registration context after session expiry, and optional unknown form fields are incorrectly treated as required, causing unnecessary `needs_input` failures.
